newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan bank viewed confidential Fed report -- Kyodo.
newsitem.headline: Japan bank viewed confidential Fed report -- Kyodo.

text.p: Japan's Kyodo News Agency reported on Thursday that Asahi Bank's New York branch could face legal action for allegedly viewing a confidential Federal Reserve inspection report this summer.
Kyodo, in a report from New York, said that the Fed considered the act malicious and was considering taking legal action against Asahi for disrupting its inspection activities.
An Asahi bank spokesman told Reuters that the company was looking into the report and would hold a news conference on their findings. But he said it was unlikely to be today.

Kyodo said Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) had been informed of the affair and would cooperate with U.S. authorities to determine any measures to be taken against the bank. The agency did not the source of its information.
A MOF official said he was not immediately able to comment on the report.
